Two New Zealand Cricketers Ruled Out of Series Decider Against England

Fast bowler Matt Henry and all-rounder Glenn Phillips have been ruled out of the decisive third One Day International (ODI) match between New Zealand and England. Both players sustained injuries, leading to their exclusion from the crucial game. This development impacts New Zealand's lineup for the series finale.
